task.assistant_response: Explain the concept of Time Division Multiple Access (TDMA) in satellite communication networks. Discuss its advantages and disadvantages compared to other multiple access techniques.

input.academic_content: Time Division Multiple Access (TDMA) is a channel access method for shared medium networks. It allows multiple users to share the same frequency channel by dividing the signal into different time slots. Each user transmits in rapid succession, one at a time, each using their own time slot. A TDMA frame consists of N time slots, one assigned to each active user. Guard times between slots prevent overlap caused by propagation delays. All users must be synchronized to a common clock to ensure correct frame alignment. Synchronization is typically achieved using a reference burst transmitted by the master station.
